en.html: I ground my back teeth together. Hard. Hard. Hard. The arms about to take a life did not stop. Because even so, there was a reason I had to fight. My justice, that was the reason. Mine alone. Push my own justice through, pronounce the enemy evil, kill him. Somewhere someone would hate me. For that person, the enemy I killed had been justice. So I was evil. Do justice, become evil. For the one I killed was evil and justice together. Good◆ and Evil◆ Balance◆ Each Other. ............Yes. That was the actthing of killing someone. I set that truth in the center of my heart. Looked directly at it. And killed one human being.
en.text:
I ground my back teeth together.

Hard. Hard. Hard.

The arms about to take a life did not stop.

Because even so, there was a reason I had to fight.

My justice, that was the reason. Mine alone. Push my own justice through, pronounce the enemy evil, kill him.

Somewhere someone would hate me. For that person, the enemy I killed had been justice. So I was evil.

Do justice, become evil.

For the one I killed was evil and justice together.

Good◆ and Evil◆

Balance◆ Each Other.

............Yes.

That was the actthing of killing someone.

I set that truth in the center of my heart.

Looked directly at it.

And killed one human being.

ja.html: 奥歯を噛む。 　強く。強く。強く。 　いま人命を奪おうとする両腕を、決して止めずに。 　何故なら。 　――それでも戦わねばならぬ理由があるから。 　理由は、つまり、俺一人の正義。 　俺一人の正義を貫いて、敵を悪と決め付けて、殺す。 　何処かで誰かが俺を憎む。 　その誰かにとって、俺が殺した敵は正義だった―― だから俺は悪なのだ。 　正義を為して悪と成る。 　殺すものは悪であり正義であるから。 　 　　　　　　　　　　　善◆悪◆ 　　　　　　　　　　　相◆殺 　…………そう。 　それが、人を殺すという行為こと。 　その真理を心の中心へ据え置いて、 　正面から見つめて、 　俺は、一個の人間を殺す。
ja.text:
奥歯を噛む。
　強く。強く。強く。

　いま人命を奪おうとする両腕を、決して止めずに。

　何故なら。
　――それでも戦わねばならぬ理由があるから。

　理由は、つまり、俺一人の正義。
　俺一人の正義を貫いて、敵を悪と決め付けて、殺す。

　何処かで誰かが俺を憎む。
　その誰かにとって、俺が殺した敵は正義だった――
だから俺は悪なのだ。

　正義を為して悪と成る。
　殺すものは悪であり正義であるから。

　
　　　　　　　　　　　善◆悪◆
　　　　　　　　　　　相◆殺

　…………そう。
　それが、人を殺すという行為こと。

　その真理を心の中心へ据え置いて、
　正面から見つめて、

　俺は、一個の人間を殺す。

en.html:
Clinging to the body, a girl screamed.

Ah—his daughter.

Her name would not come to me either. But I knew how she had loved her father.

She turned her crying-swollen eyes toward me. Fresh hatred lived in them.

Why did you kill him, the girl asked.

I gave my reason.

Even then, she cried. Yes. My reason would satisfy one person only. My justice, and nobody else's.

The girl told me what the dead man had been to her.

How good a man. How much he had loved her.

She spoke of his justice, which I had never known.

The justice I had just cut down, life and all.

It was indeed one justice.

Before that justice, I was evil.

亡骸にすがって、少女が絶叫している。
　ああ――彼の娘だ。

　名はやはり、脳裏に浮かばない。
　だが知っている――彼女が父を慕っていたこと。

　泣き腫らした瞳を、少女は俺へ向けた。
　そこには新鮮な憎悪が宿っている。

　何故殺した、と少女は言った。
　俺は理由を答えた。

　だからって、と少女は叫んだ。
　そうだろう。それは俺一人しか納得させない理由。
俺だけの正義だ。

　少女は語った。
　死んだ男が、彼女にとってどういう人間であったか。
どれほど善い人間であったか。どれほど自分を愛して
くれたか。

　俺の知らなかった、男の正義を語った。
　俺が今、命もろとも叩き斬った正義を。

　それは確かに一つの正義だった。
　その正義に対して、俺こそは邪悪だった。

A warrior descended from the zenith and <ruby>reviled<rt>reviled</rt></ruby> me.

A worthless man who killed reluctantly. A half-made thing, neither hero nor demon.

A hero kills with his chest out. A demon kills laughing. Kageaki Minato could do neither; he could have remained an ordinary man. Should have remained one. So I was told.

—No. That was wrong.

Joy, sorrow—neither made a difference. Kill for your own sake, and you are a demon.

No.

Even for an ideal, no difference. A slaughterer called a hero is a demon too.

Everyone who kills a person is a demon.

...Even now, reconsidering it, that understanding remained.

Kageaki Minato's killing of his foster mother was entirely evil.

The will that would not forgive it was entirely just.

But I had made one mistake.

I had thought evil and justice were <ruby>only that<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>.

Forgotten the possibility of other justice and other evil.

For instance... the prosecutor accusing a criminal, the judge sentencing one, the executioner carrying it out—

<ruby>those who execute justice<rt>・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>, <ruby>do they bear no guilt, no evil<rt>・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>?

The will that would not forgive it was entirely just.

ja.html:
……今、思い直してみても。
　俺の抱いた認識は、そのままに残る。

　湊斗景明の養母殺しは完全に悪業だ。
